entries.title: Three separate commanders
entries.explanation: The dictionary defines the title as a victorious general and explicitly explains this saying as work going wrong when three people oversee it. That is the source’s explanation, not a rule that three people cannot cooperate. Our editorial application asks whether responsibility and decisions have been made clear when several people supervise one task.
entries.meaning_odia: ଉତ୍ସରେ ଫତେଖାଁ ଜୟଲାଭ କରିଥିବା ସେନାପତି। ତିନି ଜଣଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ତନଖିବାର ଭାର ଥିଲେ କାମ ବିଗିଡ଼େ ବୋଲି ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହି ଢଗକୁ ବୁଝାଇଛି। ଏହା ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା; ତିନି ଜଣ କେବେ ମିଳି କାମ କରିପାରିବେନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ ଅନେକେ ତଦାରଖ କଲେ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଓ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି କେତେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ, ସେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠେ।
entries.english_summary: The source warns of divided supervision; our application asks for clear responsibilities.

entries.title: One phrase, food and body
entries.literal_meaning: One who eats dry fare becomes dry and rough.
entries.explanation: The dictionary links two senses of the repeated phrase: dry food without ghee or curry, and an unoiled, dry body. Its inserted numbers identify those senses, not spoken words. The saying makes a food-to-body connection; the entry does not verify that connection medically. Our critical reading notices the wordplay without treating someone’s food or appearance as a measure of worth.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏକେ ପଦ ଶୁଖିଲା, ଘିଅ ଓ ତିଅଣବିହୀନ ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ ଏବଂ ତେଲ ନ ଲାଗିଥିବା ଶୁଖିଲା ଦେହକୁ ବୁଝାଏ। ମଝିର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଏହି ଅର୍ଥଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଚିହ୍ନ, କହିବା ଧାଡ଼ିର ଶବ୍ଦ ନୁହେଁ। ଖାଦ୍ୟରୁ ଦେହର ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ିବା ଉତ୍ସର କଥା, ଯାଞ୍ଚିତ ଚିକିତ୍ସାତଥ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଶବ୍ଦଖେଳକୁ ଦେଖେ; ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବା ଚେହେରାରେ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପେନାହିଁ।
